tools.name: get_sig_reference
tools.description: Return the SIG feature catalog (YAML: each SIG with its signifying components and keywords). Call once, then match the issue's signals against it.

tools.name: apply_sig
tools.description: Assign a SIG to a GitHub issue. SIG_ACTION selects comment (default, posts /sig <name>), label (adds sig/<name>), or both. Dry unless LEATHER_DEMO_MODE=live.
args: name="${3#sig-}"; label="sig/${name}"; action="${SIG_ACTION:-comment}"; mode="${LEATHER_DEMO_MODE:-dry}"; if [ "$action" = comment ] || [ "$action" = both ]; then if [ "$mode" = live ]; then gh issue comment "$1" --repo "$2" --body "/sig ${name}"; else printf 'dry-mode: would comment /sig %s on issue #%s in %s\n' "$name" "$1" "$2"; fi; fi; if [ "$action" = label ] || [ "$action" = both ]; then if [ "$mode" = live ]; then gh issue edit "$1" --repo "$2" --add-label "$label"; else printf 'dry-mode: would add label %s to issue #%s in %s\n' "$label" "$1" "$2"; fi; fi

tools.name: lookup_sig
tools.description: Look up which SIGs own the given components/keywords. Pass the issue's COMPONENTS and KEYWORDS as one comma-separated list. Returns only the candidate SIGs for those terms with a tally, plus NOT_MATCH exclusions.
args:
idx="${SIG_INDEX:-sigs.index.tsv}"; q="$1"; IFS="," read -ra TS <<< "$q"; hits=""; for t in "${TS[@]}"; do   t="$(printf "%s" "$t" | sed -e "s/^[[:space:]]*//" -e "s/[[:space:]]*$//")";   [ "${#t}" -ge 3 ] || continue;   h="$(grep -iF -- "$t" "$idx" || true)";   [ -n "$h" ] && hits="$hits$h
"; done; hits="$(printf "%b" "$hits" | grep . | sort -u | head -40 || true)"; if [ -z "$hits" ]; then echo "no associations found for: $q"; exit 0; fi; echo "ASSOCIATIONS (term -> verdict -> sig):"; printf "%s
" "$hits"; echo; echo "TALLY (MATCH count per sig):"; printf '%s
' "$hits" | awk -F'	' '$2=="MATCH"{c[$3]++} END{for(s in c) print c[s]"  "s}' | sort -rn; echo; echo "EXCLUSIONS (NOT_MATCH rules the sig out for that term):"; printf '%s
' "$hits" | awk -F'	' '$2=="NOT_MATCH"{print $1"  ->  NOT "$3}' | sort -u

tools.name: lookup_sig_v2
tools.description: Given the issue's components and keywords as a comma-separated list, return the FULL catalog entries for the 2-4 candidate SIGs those terms point at, plus any NOT_MATCH exclusions. Falls back to the whole catalog when nothing matches, because an empty lookup is worse than no lookup.
args:
idx="${SIG_INDEX:-sigs.index.tsv}"; cat="${SIG_REFERENCE:-sigs.reference.yaml}"; q="$1"; IFS="," read -ra TS <<< "$q"; hits=""; for t in "${TS[@]}"; do   t="$(printf "%s" "$t" | sed -e "s/^[[:space:]]*//" -e "s/[[:space:]]*$//")";   [ "${#t}" -ge 3 ] || continue;   h="$(grep -iF -- "$t" "$idx" || true)"; [ -n "$h" ] && hits="$hits$h
"; done; hits="$(printf "%b" "$hits" | grep . | sort -u || true)"; cands="$(printf "%s\n" "$hits" | awk -F"\t" "\$2==\"MATCH\"{print \$3}" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -4 | awk "{print \$2}")"; if [ -z "$cands" ]; then echo "NO INDEX MATCH - returning the full catalog:"; cat "$cat"; exit 0; fi; echo "CANDIDATE SIGS (narrowed from the issue terms), with their catalog entries:"; echo; for s in $cands; do awk -v s="$s" "/^  - name: /{p=(\$0 ~ s\"\$\")} p" "$cat"; done; echo; echo "EXCLUSIONS (NOT_MATCH rules a sig out for that term):"; printf "%s\n" "$hits" | awk -F"\t" "\$2==\"NOT_MATCH\"{print \$1\"  ->  NOT \"\$3}" | sort -u
